level1.prompt: Sam with a crush or a partner is…

options.t: Clingy mode: wants to see them daily and share every detail.
Solo mode: loves hard, still guards solo nights and bestie nights.

level1.prompt: You show Sam the angry text you're about to send. Bad idea. Sam…

options.t: "I get why you're mad." Holds you first, talks you down later.

level1.prompt: Picture Sam's future home on a big holiday. It's…

options.t: A remix: their own rituals, their own rules, no template.
The classic: rituals, the family table, parents at ease.

level1.prompt: Sam gets a surprise bonus. By Friday…

options.t: A flight is booked. Life is short.

level1.prompt: Talking plans and life progress, Sam is…

options.t: Unbothered: who gets promoted or married when is not their business.
Ambitious: wants real wins and a direction, soon.

level1.prompt: Lines, house rules, what's fair: Sam is…

options.t: Rulebook: the same rules for everyone is the only fair way.
Case by case: rules are fixed, people aren't.

cards.prompt: Genii bets there's a friend Sam stopped inviting, just to see if the friend ever invites them. True?
cards.a: Invites whoever Sam misses. Tests are exhausting.
cards.b: Three months in, still waiting, still counting.

cards.prompt: Riley's building bans pets. Before inspection: "if anyone asks, Biscuit is YOUR pig. for like a year" What does Sam reply?
cards.a: "Not lying to a landlord. Find another way."
cards.b: "Done. Biscuit and I go way back."

cards.prompt: Sam's last big message: a breakup, a resignation, a real apology. Who actually wrote it?
cards.a: An AI drafted it. I changed three words. Sent.
cards.b: Me. Nine drafts. Sent the tenth.

cards.prompt: Every word Sam says now costs $5. Sam's best friend is shaking before a huge presentation. What does Sam do?
cards.a: Zero words. Drives them there and holds their coffee.
cards.b: $50 on ten perfect words. Worth every cent.

cards.prompt: A relative recently asked Sam: "can you help me with something?" What did Sam actually do?
cards.a: Said yes before the relative finished the sentence.
cards.b: Said yes for Saturday. Not every Saturday.

cards.prompt: The last time friends invited Sam out on a night they had saved for a big project. What won?
cards.a: Stayed in and worked. Told them "next time."
cards.b: Closed the place down with them.

cards.prompt: Genii bets Sam has someone back in their life they swore never to speak to again. Guilty or not?
cards.a: Back, and honestly closer than before.
cards.b: Not a chance. Never again means never again.

cards.prompt: A tailor knits Sam and their person one sweater with two necks. It only comes off if one of them asks. What does Sam do?
cards.a: Never asks. Learns to cook in it.
cards.b: Asks on day one. Needs their own sleeves.

cards.prompt: Sam's friends fine lateness $10. Mo works a second job for rent and is always late. Jae says fines are fines. Sam's take?
cards.a: Same fine for every person, every time.
cards.b: Mo's second job pays the rent. Waive it.

cards.prompt: A friend's closet door opens somewhere random, and Sam is invited through in an hour. Sam's weekend was already planned. Which one is Sam?
cards.a: "My weekend. Send me a postcard from wherever."
cards.b: "Through the door. The weekend can wait."

cards.prompt: Dev's talking cat has two million followers. Dev needs $5,000 for merch and offers ten percent. What does Sam reply?
cards.a: "No. A cat can stop talking any day."
cards.b: "Here's my savings. I believe in this cat."

cards.prompt: Same holiday photo, same stairs, 25 years running. Sam is abroad, and the family wants them photoshopped in. What does Sam do?
cards.a: Sends a selfie at the exact angle. The stairs must be honored.
cards.b: Sends a beach photo instead. New tradition starts now.

level3.prompt: Which of these 12 are the real Sam? Pick 4.

cards.name: Believes in second chances
cards.heart: I believe people can change, because I have.

cards.name: Likes plans set early
cards.heart: Wanting solid ground is how I take care of myself.

cards.name: Writes without AI
cards.heart: My messy real words are the truest version of me.

cards.name: Makes room for exceptions
cards.heart: I look at the person, not the form.

cards.name: First to volunteer
cards.heart: I love the world, and I'm practicing loving me too.

cards.name: Protects free time
cards.heart: My own growth is a contribution too.

cards.name: Remembers the details
cards.heart: I look after the person who got hurt first.

cards.name: Knows when to recharge
cards.heart: I charge myself first, so I have more to give.

cards.name: Loves a win
cards.heart: Wanting to build something big isn't too much.

cards.name: Starts new traditions
cards.heart: No script is the gift I gave myself.

cards.name: Keeps family traditions
cards.heart: I can hold new ideas and old wishes at the same time.

cards.name: Work stays at work
cards.heart: A good life is the whole point, not the reward for later.

stingPick.prompt: Which of these 4 lines would leave Sam speechless for three seconds?

lines.t: You love your life here. Only ever knowing here scares you more than leaving.
You'd give a second chance to someone who hasn't finished asking.
The math on your big yeses happens after the booking email.
Your privacy is just a habit. Someone you love still takes it personally.

pickTheRoast.prompt: Pick the roast Sam would laugh at hardest.

lines.t: Bragged about a $12 dupe for a full week. Unprompted.
Knows the barista's name, the barista's dog's name and its birthday.
Forgave everyone years ago. The screenshots folder did not.
Sent me a payment request for $3.47. For fries. With a fries emoji.
Calls it 'just a side project.' It has a logo and a five-year plan.
Booked the flight first. Checked the bank app second. Maybe.
